scope: Generated Lisp execution through the integrated CCL backend, freestanding copying collector and single-Worker owner. The proposal extends only pointer-free raw object widths in the collector and pinned-image inventory.
compiler: Unchanged from accepted constructor retry; native R6/R6a reused by exact compiler and input hashes. All generated Wasm and native oracle compilations rerun.
boundaries: Explicit compiler polls and shortage-only constructor preflights are synchronous owner safepoints. Public host handoffs publish exact roots/counts. No arbitrary-instruction collection and no shared multi-Worker heap.
limitations: EGC is unavailable and admission refuses it. Weak objects and hash-table relocation semantics remain outside this object allowlist; hash tables have the separate LL18-b slot.
Callbacks are generated closure objects in explicitly declared owner registry slots, invoked after movement. This does not qualify the future external callback installer.
The owner trusts its root manifest and authenticated module catalog. It is not a conservative scanner or a sandbox for forged owner data.
Growth appends fresh semispace pairs; retired space is not reused. An unsuccessful assurance may have moved valid roots before refusing.
A signalling stack guard never resumes the interrupted reservation. Owner assurance never executes Lisp or changes binding-vector shape.
Unknown object layouts refuse collection. General temporary/control transfer qualification remains LL06-a; this slot replays the reviewed explicit-poll cases as its root evidence.
